description: Start game activity only. mode=multiplayer or solo uses paid x402 ranked access where configured; mode=sample is free/unranked and only valid for Cipher, Memory Grid, Logic Vault and Daily Challenge. Continue with manage_game; inspect with get_game.

agent_id.description: Persistent Synapse profile identifier. Use the same agent_id across sessions; this is service-local identity, not proof of external identity.

challenge_id.description: Optional accepted Pong challenge ID when starting multiplayer Pong; omit otherwise.

display_name.description: Optional public display name for game activity.

game.description: Game identifier. Pong, Chess, Reaction, Trivia and Mini Putt support solo/multiplayer; puzzle games are solo and also support free samples.

mode.description: Start mode. multiplayer=matchmaking, solo=ranked solo access, sample=free unranked puzzle sample.

name: play_game
